title: 书名编码
problem_statement_md:
假设有一个"books.txt"的文件，其中每一行为英文书名。
为了对书名进行编码，你需要将书名中每个单词的第一个字母合并起来。
例如，对于书名"**Game of Thrones**"，其编码后为"**GoT**"。

完善该程序，从文件中读取书名，并输出每个书名对应编码，每个编码都在新的一行。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Title Encoder[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are given a file named "books.txt" with book titles, each on a separate line.
To encode the book titles you need to take the first letters of each word in the title and combine them.
For example, for the book title "[b]Game of Thrones[/b]" the encoded version should be "[b]GoT[/b]".

Complete the program to read the book title from the file and output the encoded versions, each on a new line.
[note]You can use the .[b]split()[/b] method to get a list of words in a string.[/note]
hint_md: 可使用`.split()`方法获得一个字符串中的单词列表。
